label: Safe advertising practices
description: The floor. Applied to every brand, and used on its own for industries with no specific template — so an unlisted industry is never generated unchecked.

rules.title: Unqualified absolute claims
rules.reason: Absolute claims like "best" or "number one" need substantiation. Add evidence to your proof points, or soften the wording.

rules.title: Guarantees without qualification
rules.reason: "Guaranteed" implies a promise you may be held to. Use it only where the guarantee is real and stated.

rules.title: Manufactured urgency
rules.reason: Urgency claims must be true. If the deadline is real, keep it; if not, this misleads.

rules.title: Targeting language about protected characteristics
rules.reason: Ad copy must not select or exclude people by a protected characteristic. Most ad platforms reject this outright.

rules.title: "Free" attached to a paid offer
rules.reason: "Free" must mean free with no purchase required. If conditions apply, state them.

rules.title: Disparaging a named competitor
rules.reason: Naming a competitor negatively invites a legal complaint and is rejected by most platforms.
